Senses.Explanation: Stick-blows and shouts are paired abrupt actions in Chan encounters, especially through the stock coupling of Deshan Xuanjian's stick and Linji Yixuan's shout. The compound names that recognizable repertoire, while the records repeatedly warn that merely labeling, imitating, or specializing in it misses the point. Yulin Tongxiu gives the paired formula: 'Deshan hits as soon as one enters the gate; Linji shouts as soon as one enters the gate' (德山入門便棒／臨濟入門便喝). Baichi Yuanshuo says that after Linji came forth he 'showed his followers only with stick and shout' (唯以棒喝示徒). Huangbo Wunian Shenyou says their blows and shouts fly back and forth (棒喝交馳), leaving no finger-hold and no place to insert a foot. Fushi Tongxian answers, 'call it stick-and-shout and you enter hell like an arrow' (喚作棒喝，入地獄如箭). Xueguan Zhiyin criticizes people who talk up Linji and do nothing but stick-and-shout (專事棒喝). Meixi Fudu heads a verse 'exhortation to those who wrongly go about with stick-and-shout' (勉謬行棒喝者), says the stick must split views of being and non-being and the shout must clear feelings of delusion and awakening (棒須劈破有無見／喝要澄空迷悟情), and ends by naming a 'stick-and-shout person' (是則名為棒喝人). Baiyu Jingsi says that for people who wrongly recognize stick-and-shout, one rebukes stick-and-shout (為謬認棒喝者呵斥棒喝). Wuyi Yuanlai asks whether the Linji house is really as claimed by people who put on a robe and immediately go about with stick-and-shout. These are attested pairings, appraisals, warnings, and corrections; the entry does not make every beating or shout an instance of this fixed compound.
Senses.Note: One corpus-wide sense. Attributions to particular masters belong to the components, not to a second meaning of the compound. The exact term occurs 992 times in 232 allowlisted texts. Attested collocations include 'blows and shouts flying back and forth' (棒喝交馳), 185 hits in 110 texts; 'one blow and one shout' (一棒一喝), 112 in 61; 'at the stick's head and under the shout' (棒頭喝下), 55 in 36; 'stick and shout applied together' (棒喝齊施), 33 in 19; and 'blows and shouts crossing together' (棒喝交加), 9 in 8. The named components are 'Deshan's stick' (德山棒), 490 hits in 173 texts, and 'Linji's shout' (臨濟喝), 442 in 155.
